notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.22.3
Updates to Stacking Suite: Stacking Suite will now recognize if you have previously calibrated images and use them if you choose. Perfect for just adding a light directory after adding more nights worth of data to quickly calibrate and register just the new subs and then stack all of them. Added logic that if you are stacking mismatched exposures into a single stack to properly weight them based on integration time. PR merged that vastly improves loading a calibrated folder if you have thousands of images.

Blink Comparator updated to persist all settings and geometries.
